title: selectNsolve Basic & Basic Plus
note: Runs inside Google Sheets as a floating dialog (AuraGuide.gs). Steps with run call helper functions in AuraGuide.gs to show things in the sheet.

steps.title: Welcome
steps.say: Welcome to selectNsolve. I'll show you how to solve an equation with plain text, right in this sheet. You can drag me anywhere on the screen.

steps.title: Math text
steps.say: selectNsolve reads any cell that contains one equal sign as math text. Let me add a short example to this sheet.

steps.title: Constants
steps.say: These two cells are constants. g equals nine point eight one, and h equals fifty. A constant is a name, an equal sign, and a number.

steps.title: The variable
steps.say: This cell is the unknown. t starts at one, with a minimum of zero and a maximum of ten. The greater-than and less-than signs set the search bounds.

steps.title: The equation
steps.say: This is the equation: h equals one half g t squared. The bar and the number after it set the precision, from zero to one.

steps.title: Select and solve
steps.say: Now select all four cells, open Extensions, choose selectNsolve, and run the solver.

steps.title: The answer
steps.say: The answer appears in the cell to the right of the variable: t is about three point one nine seconds. No formulas, no programming.

steps.title: Basic Plus
steps.say: selectNsolve Basic Plus goes further. Instead of only the cells you select, it finds equations and variables in every tab of your workbook.

steps.title: Hidden tabs
steps.say: If you choose, it also includes hidden tabs, so working notes can stay out of sight while still being solved.

steps.title: Pricing
steps.say: Basic is free forever. Basic Plus is one ninety-nine a month or fifteen dollars a year.

steps.title: Help
steps.say: For help, open the user manual at my engineering project dot com, or email support at my engineering project dot com. Thanks for watching!
